intro: A pediatric nurse wakes up in a dragon kingdom and discovers she can hear what baby dragons are thinking. It is the coziest drama on this list: less war, more problem-solving, with modern nursing know-how turning a palace maid into someone the royal family cannot do without.
why: A fresh isekai twist: the heroine's superpower is understanding a baby dragon.
Feel-good and low-stress, built on small rescues instead of brutal revenge.
A rise from maid to trusted royal nanny, with a rival who gets outplayed.
Good pick for time-travel and wish-fulfillment fans who want something light.
